model: Japanese SHVC-001 / early SHVC-CPU-01 / original SHVC-005 controllers

sources.verified: 62-pad compatible SNES/SFC footprint; two 31-position banks, 2.50 mm normal pitch and 7.50 mm adjacent-centre gaps after positions4 and27. PCB-tail row gap is not treated as spring-tip spacing.

Original Japanese SHVC-CPU-01 machine with discrete sound module; exterior top/front photograph supports handed controller banks, outboard circled port numbers, white control surrounds, raised POWER ridge, wordmark and indicator positions.
Early separate sound module and removable controller/eject assemblies; six bottom Gamebit screws.
Existing downloaded original manual depicts early SHVC-001 parts including separate upper and lower62P connectors. Current URL requests sign-in; no authentication bypass used.
5.5 x2.1 mm DC connection compatible with the HVC-002 supply shared by Japanese Famicom/SFC; original molded body dimensions unverified.
Compatible RCA plug: pin3.25+0/-0.15 mm, sleeve9 mm diameter and5.5 mm exposed length, pin projection8 mm.
Compatible RCA jack nominal8.30 mm outer diameter. Does not identify Nintendo OEM part.

photo_fit.method: Front-panel horizontal proportions compared within the same near-frontal face. Top-feature layout cross-checked after approximate planar rectification using existing model top rim; these are construction fits without manufacturing tolerances.
photo_fit.limits: Lens perspective, curved shell, worn hardware color and approximate source fonts remain uncertain. No physical specimen measured.

retained_uncertainties: Existing upper shell curvature, wall thickness and internal component shapes remain schematic.
Controller contact pitch/gender, terminal form, axial insertion depth and keyed-wall dimensions lack OEM mechanical drawings.
62-position pitch and bank separation are corroborated; original spring-tip row spacing is not derived from PCB footprints.
DC/RCA data describe compatible interfaces, not verified OEM component identities or electrically functional assemblies.
